product_or_topic: SIPEM dispensing/pouring caps and custom molds
summary: Fuller Ouedkniss snippet: SARL SIPEM (ZI Oued Smar, El Harrach; since 1982) injects PEHD/PEBD/PVC/PP, 'divers modèles de bouchons' incl. 'bouchons verseur' and 'pompettes'; offers support 'from technical study of the articles through to mold realisation'; open Sat-Thu 08:00-18:00. Page itself blocked by proxy.
implication: A local closure molder exists and sells custom-mold projects. The shampoo-maker gap is therefore more likely mold cost / MOQ / type (hinged flip-top) than 'no capability at all'. SIPEM is both the main competitor and the first call.

summary: ConformePro snippet for Algerian line 3923.50.92 'سدادات وأغطية بلاستيكية': DD 30%, TVA 19%, TCS 3%, PRCT 2%; exemptions listed (Algeria-Jordan, ZALE/GAFTA certificate of origin, health-ministry programmes). No DAPS shown in the snippet. Separate line 3923.50.91 = plastic capsules for closing/over-capping.
implication: Import protection on caps is about 30% DD + ~5% other (VAT recoverable). It is lower than the 60% DAPS seen on 3923.10. GAFTA-origin caps (e.g. from Egypt/Tunisia/Jordan) may enter duty-free. Confirm DAPS status with a transitaire.

Import benchmark about US$0.012-0.045 FOB. Landed with 30% DD + freight is about 2.8-10.7 DZD at the official rate and 5-19 DZD at the parallel rate (researcher arithmetic). A local maker cannot win on price against direct importers at the official rate. It wins on MOQ, lead time, colour and no import file.

product_or_topic: 24/410 flip-top and small screw caps China FOB
summary: Alibaba/MIC snippets: 20/24/28 mm screw caps US$0.01-0.03 (MOQ 1,000); 'instant delivery' flip-tops 20/410, 24/410, 28/410, 38/400 at US$0.01 (MOQ 10,000); 24/410 shampoo flip-top US$0.01 (MOQ 10,000). Typical MOQs 5k-50k.
implication: Stock 24/410 flip-tops are a near-commodity in China at about 1 US cent. A local offer must be built around service rather than unit price.
Disc-tops cost about 1.5x flip-tops. A local 2-piece disc-top is feasible on a 120T press but needs an assembly step.

product_or_topic: lotion pumps and trigger sprayers China FOB
summary: Lotion pump 24/410: US$0.04-0.10 (MOQ 10k); tiered 0.055 (10k) / 0.05 (100k) / 0.045 (1M). Trigger sprayer 28/410: US$0.05-0.18, about 0.09 at 10k, some 0.05 at MOQ 1k.
implication: Pumps and triggers are cheap, multi-part assemblies with metal springs. KILL for a single 120T press. Their low FOB leaves little room for local assembly.

product_or_topic: push-pull and detergent caps China FOB
summary: 28 mm push-pull caps for dish liquid: US$0.01-0.05, about 0.03 typical, MOQ about 5,000. Laundry cap with measuring cup: US$0.088 (MOQ 20k). Basic detergent screw caps: US$0.03-0.04. 38/48 mm PP detergent caps: US$0.03-0.10.
implication: Measuring caps are bulky (high freight per piece) and the best price/weight ratio among home-care closures. A secondary line, worth investigating with liquid-laundry makers.

summary: 38 mm TE caps: US$0.025-0.03 (MOQ 10k). PP 32/38/42 mm jerrycan screw caps: US$0.11 (MOQ 1k). TE caps for lube oil/jerrycans: US$0.11-0.12 (MOQ 10k).
implication: Large TE caps fit the press (4-8 cavities). Local blowers probably already cap their own jerrycans. Ask before investing.

product_or_topic: flip-top cap mold specs and prices (China)
summary: MIC listings: flip-top cap molds offered in 4/6/8/12/16 cavities (up to 48-96); cycle 10-18 s (16-cav about 20 s); 8-cav from about US$2,000; 16-cav US$8,000-15,000; listing range US$400-40,000; molds 'with inner closing system' (in-mold closing) for 28/410 available.
implication: An 8-12-cavity IMC flip-top mold at US$8-15k is affordable. The real risk is hinge and IMC quality from low-cost toolmakers. Budget a T1 sample run and hinge cycle test.

summary: Patent and trade sources: in-mold closing uses a cam sequence during ejection to close the lid so caps leave the mold closed. Industrial flip-top molds are typically about 40-50+ cavities (range 1-96). One example targeted a 16 s cycle with auto-close. Stackteck reports >1,000 IMC cavities built.
implication: Global incumbents run 40-50+ cavities. A 120T start-up with 8-12 cavities cannot match them on cost. It only competes on short runs, custom work and service.

summary: Berlin Packaging: PP flip-top 28/410 weighs 4.3 g, height 24.2 mm, max diameter 30.6 mm. Multiplastic (Mexico): 24/410 LDPE flip-top 'Precision' about 2 g, weight adjustable to customer need.
implication: Basis for the part weights and projected areas in the machine-fit calculation.

product_or_topic: SGT cap families are beverage necks
summary: SGT Algérie offers 11 PEHD cap families for necks such as 29/25, 30/25, 33 mm and 38 mm, plus handles for large bottles. Rouiba has 16-17 presses (15-16 for preforms).
implication: The dominant local cap maker covers beverage and oil necks only. None of these are cosmetic 24/410 or 28/410 dispensing closures. SGT is not a competitor for flip-tops.

summary: Dun & Bradstreet directory lists 2,383 'soap, cleaning compound and toilet preparation manufacturing' companies in Algeria (with listings by wilaya, e.g. Bouira, Aïn Témouchent, Tébessa).
implication: Directory counts include traders and dormant firms. Even so, they indicate thousands of small fillers, which is where short-run and colour closure demand sits.

product_or_topic: startup shampoo brand looking for components
summary: Kompass lead snippet: a small Algiers company starting in cosmetics (shampoo and shower gel) is seeking suppliers of finished products or formulas and components. Date and name not visible; page blocked.
implication: Small shampoo start-ups publicly look for component suppliers. This profile matches the founder's shampoo maker. These firms are first-wave customers.

summary: Sagaci Research: in Algerian surface care and cleaners the most common pack size is 75 cl and the plastic bottle is the most frequent format.
implication: Supports demand for 28 mm screw, flip-top and trigger closures on 75 cl bottles in home care.

summary: At Cosmetica North Africa the minister urged hygiene, detergent and deodorant producers to source packaging from local steelmakers (Tosyali, El Hadjar, AQS). He put the market at more than 40,000 t/yr.
implication: Localising packaging inputs is official policy. Local aerosol cans would raise demand for aerosol overcaps and actuators (injection). Plastic closures could use the same 'import substitution' narrative when pitching buyers.

product_or_topic: Algeria imports of HS 3923 from China
summary: Trading Economics snippet: Algeria imported US$12.08M of 'articles for conveyance or packing of goods; stoppers' (HS 3923 heading) from China in 2017. The 3923.50-specific value was not found.
implication: The value is old and covers the whole heading. Still needed: 3923.50 imports for 2022-2025 (ITC Trade Map / DGD) to size cap imports.

summary: About 37 Phase 2 queries in FR/AR/EN, including Ouedkniss-, Facebook- and Instagram-restricted searches ('bouchon flip top', 'bouchon shampoing fournisseur', 'سدادات الشامبو', 'أغطية فليب توب', 'bouchon doseur/verseur', 'pénurie emballage'). They found no Algerian flip-top or disc-top producer, no DZD price for any cosmetic closure, and no press report of a closure shortage. Ouedkniss, Kompass and ConformePro pages are blocked by the proxy.
implication: No evidence of a nationwide closure shortage, and also no visible local dispensing-closure supply. This fits a niche or service gap more than a shortage. Only interviews can resolve it.

summary: An Algerian shampoo maker reportedly could not find a local producer for a cap. Researcher could not find any public trace. Cap type, neck, volume and the reasons given by suppliers are all UNKNOWN.
implication: This is the only direct pain signal in the closures topic. It must be verified by interview (question list in p2_closures.md) before any mold spend.
